svg.title: Coupon Rush Kafka topic structure
svg.desc: The current application sends every coupon issue event to one coupon-issue topic. With the default single partition, all coupon keys share partition 0 on one broker. More partitions would route equal coupon IDs to the same partition.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', 'Noto Sans KR', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif
